content: Table TABREF36 lists the results. Overall speaking, one-to-many fertility is consistently more important on all three language pairs, which confirms our hypothesis. On the contrary, null-aligned words receive much less attention, which shows a persistently decrease on three language pairs. It is also reasonable since null-aligned input words contribute almost nothing to the translation outputs.
